title: pabstiella aurantiaca
intro: Pabstiella aurantiaca, commonly known as the Orange Pabstiella, is a species of orchid that belongs to the Pabstiella genus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to stimulate the immune system and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Pabstiella aurantiaca are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are thought to be responsible for its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are known to possess medicinal properties.
